**Job Description

**In Credit Risk Model Validation (CRMV), we are reimagining model risk management across Danske Bank, moving from manual data wrangling, ad hoc scripts, and copied notebooks towards an industrialised, reproducible, AI-accelerated quantitative engineering ecosystem.

To realise this vision, we are looking for a Senior Model Validation Quant who bridges quantitative model validation and software and infrastructure engineering. You will combine strong quantitative skills with sound engineering practices to validate models, build our core validation software, and configure modern cloud workflows.

Enabling the team to perform high-quality, repeatable validations is as important as running them yourself. Your initial focus will be roughly 70% direct model validation and 30% tooling and infrastructure engineering, adapting as our platform and automation mature.

You will join a skilled, collaborative, forward-thinking team of risk professionals migrating to GitHub Enterprise Cloud and Databricks, building modular internal Python packages, configuring Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs) and GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows, and using GitHub Copilot as a daily engineering partner.

**What you will be doing:

**

• Perform and lead model validations: independently validate credit risk models (e.g. PD, LGD, CF, and IFRS 9), assessing conceptual soundness, statistical performance, and model limitations.

• Build and evolve validation software: design, implement, and maintain core Python packages and shared libraries that translate quantitative methodologies into clean, parameter-driven, testable tools.

• Enable the department: create tools and automated templates that help fellow validators run analyses, generate standard evidence bundles, and produce publication-ready PDF reports with minimal manual effort.

• Design modern workflows and infrastructure: set up and manage GitHub Actions workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs) for automated, audit-ready execution across environments.

• Integrate AI-assisted engineering: use GitHub Copilot extensively each day to accelerate code delivery, write comprehensive test suites, and modernise legacy codebases.

• Promote engineering excellence: promote sound version control practices, structured code reviews, and reproducible analyses across the team.

• Engage key stakeholders: clearly and persuasively present technical architectures, quantitative findings, and validation conclusions to model developers, risk leaders, and regulatory counterparts.

**About you:

**

• Quantitative grounding: you have an MSc or PhD, or equivalent practical experience, in a quantitative discipline (e.g. mathematics, statistics, computer science, physics, quantitative finance, data science, or engineering).

• Strong coding practices: you have solid practical experience writing clean, modular Python and SQL code.

• Collaborative version control (Git is essential): you are confident with Git branching strategies, pull requests, automated checks, and collaborative code reviews.

• Infrastructure and automation mindset: you have practical experience with, or a strong interest in learning, platforms such as Databricks (including DABs) and GitHub Actions.

• Enthusiasm for AI tooling: you are keen to use GitHub Copilot daily to enhance your workflow. Prior experience is a plus, but curiosity and openness to AI-assisted coding matter most.

• Bridge-builder mindset: you enjoy combining quantitative modelling with software engineering and switching between building infrastructure and exploring model mechanics.

• Clear communicator: you communicate clearly and warmly in English, translating technical and mathematical nuances into accessible insights for colleagues with varied backgrounds.

**What we offer you:

**This position can be located both in Denmark and Lithuania. If the position is located in Lithuania, the salary range will be from 3280 EUR to 4920 EUR gross (based on your competencies relevant for the job) and your contractual job title will be Risk Methodology & Model Validation.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**Does this sound like the opportunity you have been looking for? We would like to hear from you.

If you have any questions, please contact Morten Gadegaard Jørgensen mojrg@danskebank.dk

Are you a hands-on, security focused engineer ready to help build a technical security foundation? If you thrive on turning compliance frameworks into real-world technical control while staying closely connected to daily operations, this job is for you.

Working closely with our Head of IT and Security, you will turn our ISMS (ISO/IEC 27001, NIS2, and the EU AI Act) into operating technical reality by designing, implementing, and operating the controls, tooling, and secure configurations that protect Space Inventor across our Corporate, Missions, and SatOPS zones. This is a role focused on establishing new capabilities rather than maintaining an existing setup. Alongside hands-on security engineering, you will co-own and deliver day-to-day IT support, keeping you grounded in user needs and the operational reality of our environment.

Given Space Inventors work you must be eligible for a Danish Personnel Security Clearance.

The job is located in Aalborg, Denmark.

Your Responsibilities

• Core Security & Tooling: Design, implement, and operate core security controls and tooling (EDR, logging/SIEM, vulnerability management, email, and endpoint security).

• Identity & Access Management: Build and harden the identity foundation (Entra ID security, MFA, Conditional Access, PAM, Windows LAPS, and access governance).

• Hardening & Infrastructure: Establish endpoint and server hardening baselines (CIS benchmarks) enforced via Intune; support secure design for infrastructure rebuilds and Entra ID/M365 migrations.

• Network & Zone Security: Implement network security and segmentation across our three zones (Corporate, Missions, SatOPS), including the overlay for OT and the SatOPS ground segment.

• Vulnerability Management & Incident Response: Scan, prioritize, remediate, and verify vulnerabilities; build detection, alerting, playbooks, and hands-on investigation/recovery.

• Automation & Architecture: Automate security operations via PowerShell/scripting; contribute to technical roadmaps, document controls, and serve as a technical security resource.

• Compliance & Governance: Implement technical controls behind the Statement of Applicability and produce evidence for ISO 27001 certification and NIS2 compliance.

• IT Operations & Support: Co-own and deliver day-to-day service desk support, troubleshooting endpoint/user issues, Microsoft 365, onboarding/offboarding, and hardware/AV lifecycles.

Qualifications

Experience: 3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in IT security engineering or SecOps specifically building or maturing controls from scratch combined with solid IT support experience. Experience from regulated, manufacturing, critical-infrastructure, or OT environments is an advantage (space experience is not required).

Technical Proficiencies:

• Hands-on security engineering across endpoints, identity, cloud, and networks.

• Microsoft security stack: Entra ID, Conditional Access, Intune, M365 security, Defender (EDR), and ideally Sentinel or a comparable SIEM.

• Hardening baselines (CIS), patch management, and vulnerability scanning.

• Network security: Firewalls, segmentation, VPNs, and traffic monitoring.

• Scripting and automation with PowerShell.

• Incident response, triage, and log analysis.

Standards & Compliance: Solid working knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001 and NIS2 requirements; awareness of OT / IEC 62443 is a strong plus.

Education & Certifications: Degree in IT/cybersecurity or equivalent proven experience. Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft SC-200/AZ-500/SC-100, CompTIA Security+/CySA+, or GIAC GSEC/GCIH) are an advantage.

Personal Attributes: A builder mindset with strong initiative; pragmatic and risk-oriented; structured with audit-ready documentation; and a clear, discreet communicator who collaborates well across technical and non-technical teams.

What We Offer

• A full-time role with exposure to a variety of disciplines within space technology.

• A position in an exciting, rapidly growing industry with significant international reach.

• A chance to shape your role and responsibilities within a growing company.

• Great colleagues and several social events each year.

• Health insurance and additional employee benefits.

• Competitive salary and good working conditions.

How to Apply

If you’re ready to take your career to the next level, apply by submitting your CV and application. If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact us via jobs@space-inventor.com, and we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

Interviews are held continuously until the right candidate is found.

Start date to be agreed, but preferably with start-up as soon as possible.

We look forward to receiving your application.

About Space Inventor

Space Inventor is a leading Satellite company with a passion for exploring space and delivering innovative solutions in satellite technology. Our mission is to revolutionize the space industry with creativity, technical expertise, and reliability. With our 250+ years of combined experience in the space industry, we are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what satellites can achieve.

The Department of Food Science at Aarhus University is seeking an Experimental Technician for a permanent position, starting on 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position will focus on field-grown vegetables and pulses.

Start date and duration
1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. This is a permanent position on 32 hours per week. 

Job description

• 
Day-to-day care and maintenance of field trials involving vegetable crops and other annual crops

• 
Soil cultivation and weed control using a range of machinery and weeding methods

• 
Prevention and control of pests and other harmful organisms

• 
Harvesting, grading, storage and recording of field-grown crops

• 
Planning and carrying out field trials

• 
General horticultural tasks across the department involving vegetables and fruit

• 
Tasks are planned and carried out as part of a team of experienced horticulturalists and agricultural technicians, together with seasonal staff.

Your profile

• 
Day-to-day maintenance of areas used for agricultural crops outside experimental trials, as well as trials involving annual crops and fruit and berry species

• 
Soil cultivation and weed control using a range of machinery and weeding methods

• 
Prevention and control of pests and other harmful organisms

• 
Harvesting, grading, handling and storage of field-grown crops

• 
Handling soil samples

• 
Necessary certificates for operating the machinery available at AU-Auning for relevant field tasks

General horticultural tasks across the department involving vegetables

Tasks are planned and carried out as part of a team of experienced horticulturalists and agricultural technicians, together with seasonal staff.

Who we are
The Department of Food Science is part of the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University. Its research covers a wide range of areas, including horticulture, fruit and vegetables, food quality and biochemistry, as well as sensory science and consumer science.

The department has approximately 60 full-time research staff, 70 PhD students and postdoctoral researchers, and 30 visiting students and researchers.

Most of the department's staff are based at Agro Food Park 48 in Skejby. Field trials involving outdoor crop production are carried out at AU Auning, near Gl. Estrup on the Djursland peninsula, where the team comprises five permanent staff members and two seasonal employees.

The department is characterised by openness, equality, dialogue and a strong sense of community. We consider these values an important part of the department's strategy and working environment.

Find out more about the Department of Food Science at www.food.au.dk.

What we offer

• 
A varied range of tasks in the field, orchard, workrooms and machinery shed

• 
An exciting workplace as part of a young, dedicated team

• 
Tasks tailored to your skills and competencies

• 
The opportunity to learn a great deal about vegetable production

• 
An insight into the world of research

• 
The opportunity to develop skills in planning and carrying out field trials

• 
A workplace in beautiful natural surroundings

• 
A workplace where employees are at the heart of everything we do

• 
Freedom and responsibility

• 
A job that contributes to the green transition

Place of work and area of employment
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the duty station is the AU-Auning Field Research Station, Department of Food Science, Gl. Estrup, Randersvej 8 H, 8963 Auning, Denmark.

Contact information
For further information, please contact: Assoc. Prof. Antonios Petridis, tel.: 20 63 36 82, email: apetridis@food.au.dk

Applications must be received no later than 25 November 2026.

The engineering team at Chainalysis is inspired by solving the hardest technical challenges and building products that establish trust in cryptocurrencies. We're a global organisation that thrives on challenging work and doing it alongside exceptionally talented teammates. Our industry evolves rapidly, and our mission is to build a flexible, AI-driven platform that automates entity resolution, optimises data labelling pipelines, and creates predictive models that identify illicit patterns before they escalate.

Our data and solutions have been used to solve some of the world's most high-profile criminal cases and grow consumer access to cryptocurrency safely. Now, by pairing the industry's most trusted blockchain data with agents that reason, investigate, and act, we help our customers scale their workflows as the cryptocurrency economy becomes increasingly mainstream.

As a Staff Software Engineer within Investigations, you'll be a driving force in a team of engineers, taking ownership of technical direction and sharing responsibility for providing the right tools and the right data to build best in class customer experiences. You'll lead the design, build and maintenance of new customer facing web-features as well as the APIs and services backing them. A key part of this role is partnering closely with product managers and designers, leveraging your deep understanding of the underlying data platform to deliver impactful, scalable solutions to our customers.

**In This Role, You'll

**

• Lead the architecture, maintenance and development of serving cloud-native data ingest and aggregation processes that intake gigabytes of data per day

• Drive the delivery of features across our product suite that detect activities for market manipulation, fraud, behavioural patterning, and more

• Own and scale a high-performance services on AWS that handle thousands of requests per second

• Lead the team's modernisation efforts towards a streaming architecture, setting technical direction and best practices

• Own and drive the direction and enablement of our graphing platform, which is used across multiple products to drive and visualize understanding of our insights and data, both on and off the blockchains

• Debug and resolve production issues across multiple systems and services, guiding the team through complex technical challenges

• Mentor and grow engineers across the team, fostering a culture of technical excellence and collaboration

**We're Looking For Candidates Who Have

**

• Proven experience leading the design and implementation of cloud-native services-based systems in a major cloud provider like AWS or GCP

• A strong track record of mentoring engineers, leading cross-team projects, and driving design and technology decisions at a senior or lead level

• The ability to align technical execution with product and design partners, with a strong bias to ship and iterate

• Deep experience with object-oriented programming languages; we mostly use Java and typescript but appreciate a variety of languages!

• A strong technical background with extensive experience working directly on complex backend and/or frontend systems and projects, including in leadership or lead engineer roles

• Great pride from taking ownership of product ideas from inception through to production

• Good understanding of both frontend and backend best practices and paradigms.

• Integrated AI impactfully in customer-facing products or engineering infrastructure

**You Might Also Have

**

• Experience with AI-friendly and driven systems

• Exposure to or interest in the cryptocurrency technology ecosystem

• Terraform and Kubernetes knowledge

**Technologies We Use

**

• Java (Spring Boot)

• Typescript (React, Angular)

• Kafka (Warpstream)

• K8S

• Terraform

• PostgreSQL

**AI at Chainalysis

**AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

**About Chainalysis

**Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

**You belong here.

**At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

Compensation Range: DKK 870,000 - DKK 1,175,000

We are looking for a Software Engineer who wants to build and ship new features that quickly reach customers, on top of an engine that already runs at scale. You join our platform team, which owns several live domains that our customers depend on every day. The foundations are solid and well maintained, so your time goes into new use cases and features rather than firefighting. Whether you have a couple of years of experience or a few more, we would like to see your application.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Hear directly from the people using what you build. Customer feedback feeds straight back into the roadmap, and you work on features and product decisions that matter to end users.

• Build on a system with real scale behind it. The event system spans 8 domains, exposes 20+ event types as webhooks, and powers 10 configurable alert types for our end users - currently ~20k active configurations triggering ~200k events every weekday. The team owns 8+ public APIs end to end, crucial for customers' day-to-day business.

• Learn from experts who share. You’ll join a talkative team of experienced domain experts who love discussing technical topics.

• Grow with support. Scoped, well-defined assignments to start, senior colleagues pairing and reviewing your work, and shared ownership of keeping things running.

• See your work ship. We favour small, frequent releases over long project cycles, so what you build lands in production fast.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend developer with strong Java skills who is at home on live production systems.

• Hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and REST APIs, in particular building and running your own services in a modern cloud-based microservice and event-driven architecture.

• You are comfortable working on live production systems with high data volumes and migration paths, keeping quality, observability, reliability, and performance in mind.

• You enjoy talking tech: you like discussing technical topics widely, learning, and listening in on topics not always directly related to your own tasks.

• You are motivated by incremental, high-quality delivery on products that are already live, bringing a fresh perspective that helps rework existing infrastructure where it is holding us back, and you treat the tools already in our platform as solid building blocks.

• Nice to have: Flink and stateful processing (or the willingness to learn it, since it is widely used here), relational databases, and Grafana and Prometheus, our “bread and butter”.

You embrace AI as part of how you engineer. From prototyping through to production, you use AI tools as an integrated part of your workflow, not as a shortcut but as a force multiplier. That said, this isn't the main thing we're hiring for: curiosity and a willingness to use it well matter more than deep prior experience.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Improve, extend and run the live domains our team owns, including telemetry storage and APIs, the event system, and the alerting engine, without disrupting production.

• Build and run your own services, with migration paths when architecture or data formats need to change.

• Work closely with the internal teams building products on top of the platform you help shape.

• Keep the platform reliable and observable at high data volumes.

****Our hiring process

****Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a lead engineer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

You’ll help shape the systems that keep a leading energy trading business accurate and compliant, while giving us the capacity to modernise our solutions and build what comes next.

Here’s what the job entails

In the role, your primary function will be to design, build and improve C# solutions for what happens after an energy trade is captured: settlement, invoicing and regulatory reporting. As an experienced engineer, you will take ownership of solutions from ideas to production while helping make knowledge and ownership more distributed across the team. You will gain valuable insight into energy trading and financial regulation, while working with modern engineering approaches such as event-driven architecture and AI-assisted development.

More specifically, your responsibilities include:

• designing, developing and maintaining C# services that turn every energy trade we make into correct accurate invoices, settlements and regulatory reports

• taking ownership of your solutions from idea to production, spotting and addressing issues early before they affect the business

• analysing how our current systems and data work, and simplifying complex or ageing solutions to make them easier to run, understand and change

• working closely with the product manager, product owner and solution architect to turn business needs, including regulatory rules, into well-tested and well-documented solutions

• sharing your knowledge through code reviews, documentation and mentoring, helping build shared knowledge and ownership across the team

Meet your team

You will join our Late Trade Flow team, where we work with the systems that handle trades after they are made. An important focus for the team is modernising these solutions and building the foundation for the next stage of the business, increasingly using event-driven architecture and AI.

We are a team of software and data engineers, supported by a product manager, product owner and solution architect, working side by side with our finance and trading colleagues. We value ownership, openness and learning from each other, and we actively share knowledge through collaboration, mentoring and feedback. As a curious and proactive team, we continuously explore how new technology and better ways of working can improve the solutions we build.

But enough about us… over to you!

As you will be working with business-critical solutions, we imagine that you enjoy taking ownership and following your work from idea to production. You take a proactive approach to challenges, spotting issues and opportunities early and acting on them. At the same time, you enjoy working closely with others, sharing your knowledge and learning from the people around you.

Furthermore, we imagine that you:

• have solid professional experience developing production software in C# and .NET

• have practical experience with domain-driven design and event-driven architecture

• bring an analytical approach to problem solving, including working with data and complex business rules

• have experience working in agile teams and contributing to product development

Help us evolve the technical foundation for digital manufacturing at VELUX. As IIoT Platform Technical Lead, you will lead the technical direction of our shared IIoT platform while taking part in engineering. You will enable development teams to build manufacturing applications through reliable connectivity, standardised shop floor data and reusable platform services.

Meet your future team

You will join the Industrial IoT Platform Team, part of IT & Digital Enablement. The team develops and maintains the shared IIoT platform that supports manufacturing applications through connectivity, data and reusable technical capabilities.

As IIoT Platform Technical Lead, you will provide day-to-day technical leadership across the engineering group. Working closely with senior IIoT platform engineers, architects, vendors and manufacturing stakeholders, you will coordinate decisions, coach engineers and help move delivery forward. The role has no formal people-management responsibility.

What We Offer

This role combines contributing to the shared IIoT platform’s technical direction with direct engineering work. You will lead day-to-day technical direction and engineering execution, contributing to design, development, testing, reviews and complex problem-solving. You will turn product priorities into a coherent platform roadmap, engineering practices and clear guardrails.

You will balance a clear technical direction with close collaboration, involving the team in technical decisions and finding practical compromises that support both platform integrity and delivery needs.

The goal in this role means a clear and maintained platform roadmap, faster onboarding and greater reuse, improved visibility of platform health, and well-defined ownership between shared platform capabilities and domain-specific application logic.

Department of Agroecology at Aarhus University, Denmark, is looking for a full-time Data manager to work at the Center for Landscape Research in Sustainable Agricultural Futures (Land-CRAFT).

Land-CRAFT addresses three of our major societal challenges - food security, climate change, and loss of biodiversity. With Center partners from University of Copenhagen, Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (Germany), and Colorado State University (USA), we bring together expertise in climate impact research, landscape analyses, biogeochemistry, agronomy, biology, and geography to develop solution – oriented research that extends across multiple spatial and temporal scales. Established in June 2022, Land-CRAFT has built a dynamic team to undertake both fundamental and applied research aimed to reduce the environmental impact of agricultural systems, specifically regarding greenhouse gas emissions. To reach our goals, we are using a combination of empirical, field-based approaches, digital technologies, including modelling and remote sensing, while closely interacting with stakeholders. The position we advertise here is aimed at supporting these activities with respect to data management. The new employee will become part of a support team with complementary skills and work collaboratively in an active and international research environment with diverse projects and people across Department of Agroecology.

The position is available from 1st March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The duration of the position is 3 years.

Your main role as part of the support team at Land-CRAFT will be to support research activities of the staff and research students (at BSc, MSc, and PhD levels) in data management, analysis and statistics. • 
Organize, archive, and document data collected by the Land-CRAFT team, including with appropriate metadata protocols

Manage data transfer/sharing among Center partners and external collaborators following FAIR data principles, AU rules and regulations, and GDPR rules

Stay close to the code. Lead a development team. Help shape how we build software at Dalux.

Dalux is growing, and we are looking for experienced software developers who want to combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership.

As a Team Lead, you lead from within the development team. Around half of your time is spent developing software, while the rest is focused on technical direction, product collaboration, planning, mentoring, and helping your team perform at its best.

You will have significant influence on both the products we build and how we build them – including how we use agentic AI across software development.

Your role

Each Dalux development team owns one or more areas of our product portfolio, including its functionality, architecture, quality, performance, reliability, and long-term technical health.

As Team Lead, you are the technical anchor of the team. You work closely with developers, a Product Manager, and a Product Designer to understand problems, set technical direction, and turn product priorities into high-quality software.

This is primarily a technical leadership role rather than a traditional people-management position, and you will spend approximately 50% of your time developing software hands-on.

The rest of your role typically includes:

• Setting technical direction and defining architectural solutions with the team

• Working with the Product Manager to understand requirements, challenge scope, and translate priorities into development work

• Planning and prioritizing work while maintaining a healthy and sustainable flow

• Helping the team break down complex technical and product problems

• Mentoring developers through technical sparring, reviews, and day-to-day collaboration

• Taking responsibility for the quality and long-term health of your team's software

• Identifying opportunities to improve architecture, tools, development practices, and ways of working

• Driving improvements beyond your own team when they can make Dalux Development better

We expect Team Leads to have opinions, challenge existing approaches, and create clarity when there is no obvious answer.

Leading development with agentic AI

We are significantly increasing our use of agentic AI in software development.

We use and explore AI across the development lifecycle – from understanding problems and navigating codebases to implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and review.

As a Team Lead, you are expected to have hands-on experience using agentic AI in your own development workflow. The specific tools matter less than how you use them: providing the right context and direction, critically evaluating the output, and knowing when to intervene or take a different approach.

Your role goes beyond your own workflow. You will help your team experiment with agentic development, identify where it genuinely improves engineering effectiveness, share useful practices, and maintain the engineering judgment and quality standards required for production software.

AI can increase what capable developers can achieve, but responsibility for architecture, correctness, maintainability, and quality remains with the team.

Technologies we work with

Our platform is built on a distributed cloud architecture using AWS.

Depending on the team, you may work with technologies such as:

• Full-stack: C# / .NET, Angular / TypeScript, GitHub Copilot, MSSQL, Elasticsearch, WebGL, DirectX

• Mobile: .NET MAUI, Vulkan

• AI and Computer Vision: C++, Python, computer vision and machine learning technologies

Which team you lead depends on your technical background, interests, leadership experience, and where we see the strongest match.

Product development at Dalux

Our developers do more than implement specifications.

Developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers work together to understand problems and find solutions that balance user value, usability, technical feasibility, business viability, and long-term technical health.

As Team Lead, you bring the technical perspective into those discussions. You help the team understand why we are building something, challenge proposed solutions when necessary, and ensure technical considerations are part of product decisions from the beginning.

Your background

You are an experienced software developer who enjoys taking responsibility beyond your own code.

You may already be a Team Lead or Lead Developer. Or you may be the developer others turn to when a difficult technical decision needs to be made, a problem needs structure, or another developer needs help moving forward.

We expect that you:

• Have solid professional software development experience

• Have at least six months of practical experience using agentic AI as part of your software development workflow

• Have an educational background in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related technical field

• Have experience taking a key technical role within a development team

• Are comfortable making and facilitating technical decisions

• Enjoy mentoring and helping other developers improve

• Can create structure and direction without controlling every detail

• Have strong communication, facilitation, and planning skills

• Care about maintainability, reliability, performance, and engineering quality

• Understand how to balance short-term delivery with long-term technical health

• Can identify opportunities to improve development practices and ways of working

Experience with our exact technology stack is useful, but technical judgment, leadership ability, and strong software engineering fundamentals matter more.

What You Can Expect From Dalux

Dalux is a software company at heart, and software development is central to how we create value.

As a Team Lead, you can expect:

• Hands-on engineering – leadership does not mean leaving software development behind

• Real technical influence – short paths between ideas, discussions, and decisions

• Meaningful team ownership – teams own both product functionality and the technology behind it

• Strong technical colleagues – daily sparring with developers who care about what they build

• Close product collaboration – developers work directly with Product Managers and Product Designers

• Room to improve how we work – Team Leads are expected to challenge and evolve our development practices

• An environment actively investing in agentic AI – with the opportunity to shape how your team works with it

• High levels of trust and freedom in how you and your team solve problems

All Dalux software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen.

We believe working together in person makes technical collaboration, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and fast decision-making significantly easier.

About Dalux

Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, we develop software used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house, giving our developers and technical leaders the opportunity to influence both the products and the technology behind them.

Ready to lead from within the team?

If you want greater technical responsibility and influence while continuing to build software hands-on, we would like to hear from you.

If agentic AI is already part of how you develop software, tell us how you use it – and how you think a development team can use it effectively without compromising engineering quality.

We recruit continuously and hire multiple Team Leads as Dalux continues to grow.

Applications are invited for a two-year, fixed-term position as Project Coordinator in Professor Daan van Aalten’s research group at the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics, Aarhus University.

Expected start date and duration of employment
This is a two-year position, starting on 15 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The working hours are 30 hours per week.

Job description
As Project Coordinator, you will support Professor Daan van Aalten’s research group and its externally funded projects at the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics, Aarhus University.

Your main tasks will be to:

• Coordinate the administration of an international research project with the University of Aberdeen and the Telethon Institute of Genetics and Medicine (TIGEM) in Pozzuoli, Italy. This includes arranging partner meetings and following up on agreed actions and deadlines.
• Assist researchers with organizing and structuring research data, including patient data received from collaborators at TIGEM.
• Support grant applications and prepare and update project budgets, including staff costs, employment periods and overheads.
• Keep project documentation up to date and work with AU finance and research support staff on budget changes and reporting requirements.
• Support recruitment and contract extensions in cooperation with HR, and coordinate practical arrangements when researchers, students and visiting staff join or leave the group, including AU access, introductions and handovers.
• Organize group meetings, workshops and retreats, and arrange visits by collaborators and prospective group members.
• Prepare and update internal guides and onboarding materials, including information about group contacts, equipment responsibilities and practical laboratory routines.
• Prepare staff surveys and follow up on feedback about communication, working routines and the working environment.
You will also help group members with AU administrative systems and procedures, put them in contact with the relevant university services and handle other administrative tasks as needed.

Your profile
Applicants must hold a master’s degree or equivalent qualification. A PhD is an advantage, particularly in relation to working in an academic research environment.

We are looking for a proactive, well-organized colleague with good communication skills. You should be able to work independently, prioritize your tasks and keep track of deadlines.

Experience with research administration, grant applications and project budgets, including staff costs and overheads, is an advantage. Knowledge of university HR and finance procedures and experience with recruitment support and onboarding would also be useful.

You should be fluent in written and spoken Danish and English and enjoy working with researchers, students and administrative staff. Knowledge of Italian is an advantage when working with colleagues at TIGEM.

Who we are
The Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics is part of the Faculty of Natural Sciences, Aarhus University and comprises research within the areas of Plant Molecular Biology, Neurobiology, RNA Biology and Innovation, Protein Science,

Cellular Health, Intervention and Nutrition. There are currently 75 full-time scientific staff and 95 PhD students. The department is responsible for two educations: Molecular Biology and Molecular Medicine with a yearly uptake of 160 students in total.

Please refer to http://mbg.au.dk/ for further information about The Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics and to https://nat.au.dk/ and http://www.au.dk/ for information on Faculty of Natural Sciences and Aarhus University, respectively.

What we offer
We offer a varied administrative role in an international research environment, with close collaboration with researchers, students and university administrative staff. The position provides opportunities to develop experience in research administration, grant support and project coordination, and to contribute to the organization and working environment of the research group.

Place of work and area of employment
The place of work is at Universitetsbyen 81, 8000 Aarhus C, and the area of employment is Aarhus University with affiliated institutions.
